title: Nowhere-Zero Perturbations of Nonclosed One-Forms
statement: Let $M$ be a closed manifold with $\chi(M)=0$, and let $\alpha$ be a one-form on $M$ with $d\alpha\neq0$. Does there exist a smooth function $f$ such that $\alpha+df$ has no zeros?
